question: How fragile is the surrogate-MSE q0-landscape to ω-misspecification, and how wide is the truth-ω tube within which truth-q0 remains the argmin?
hypothesis: Surrogate-MSE is ω-fragile; truth-q0 is the argmin only inside a thin tube around truth-ω, ruling out decoupled ω-outer / q0-inner search.
narrative_md: Probing 511 Sobol-q0 + truth across 24 ω-perturbations on 3 seeds: surrogate-MSE is extremely ω-fragile. Truth-q0 is the argmin only inside a thin tube (|Δω-dir| ≲ 1°, |Δω-mag| ≲ 2-5%); outside it the argmin slides >100° and truth_q0_mse explodes 3-4 OOM. Only 11/72 cells keep argmin within 10° of truth. Structurally explains m115's seed-91 failure (its ω-DE searched far wider than the tube) and rules out any decoupled ω-outer / q0-inner architecture — (q0, ω) must be jointly and tightly coupled.
